claim: All Amazon Managed Grafana user licenses are per workspace, per month; an Editor license costs $9 per active editor or administrator user per workspace.

evidence.quote: All user licenses are per workspace, per month.

An Amazon Managed Grafana Editor license costs $9 per active editor or administrator user per workspace and provides the user with administrative permissions for managing workspace users, creating and managing dashboards and alerts, and assigning permissions to access data sources.
